description: Cloudflare optimization experiment catalog. These variants are benchmark controls and diagnostics, not headline scoreboard peers.

sourceRequirements.source: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets and framework adapter output should serve hashed assets with long-lived immutable cache headers.
Cloudflare Static Assets binding can route static matches before Worker code unless run_worker_first forces Worker execution.
Smart Placement and service bindings can change latency/runtime placement and must be isolated from framework-runtime ranking.
OpenNext Cloudflare supports static-asset, R2, regional, queue, and tag-cache choices that materially affect Next.js Workers behavior.
Wrangler/workerd local checks should prove generated Worker entrypoints start before live benchmark runs.
Cloudflare trace headers and cf-ray colos should be captured so live benchmark outliers can be correlated with edge placement.
Vinext is useful as a Cloudflare-owned Vite/Next diagnostic comparator, but must stay excluded from framework ranking.

rankingPolicy.canonical: Never mix optimization variants into headline framework scoreboards.
rankingPolicy.optimized: Optimized variants may be compared only inside the same route contract, rendering contract, and optimization class.
rankingPolicy.diagnostic: Diagnostic comparators can be built or probed, but remain excluded from ranking.

verification.static: cloudflare:optimization-audit requires _headers coverage when an enabled Worker target has static assets.
verification.runtime: contract tests and result reports capture route cache-control and cf-cache-status headers.

variants.purpose: Measure the CDN/static-assets ceiling for wrapper and Worker-baseline apps without changing their source routes.
Keep document/API benchmark routes Worker-first while still disclosing static asset serving behavior.

variants.negativeControl: Do not compare this variant against canonical single-Worker framework-runtime rows unless the placement mode is part of the bucket key.

variants.purpose: SSG/prerender cache control for the repo's prerendered Next.js blog routes.

openNextConfig.tagCache: d1NextTagCache or doShardedTagCache when on-demand revalidation is in scope

variants.purpose: Catch generated Worker entrypoints that build but cannot start under workerd before live runs.
Make edge location and cache state explicit in row hashes and aggregate result summaries.
Use as a Cloudflare-maintained diagnostic reference for Vite/Next-on-Workers behavior without treating it as a framework peer.
